outlook.statement: The Company expects to increase its revenue and the profitability in the coming year as the business has started showing growth and the economy as a whole has moved to its revival and future of the Company looks very bright. There is no dearth of demand and the Company is well shaped to cope up itself with the market expectations.
Markups are very Low, but expecting good results in future.

In the coming year financial year 2025-26, we are foreseeing increase in demand since few export customers have started shifting their orders from China to India. Product mix more focused on sustainability having innovative finishes and accordingly new fabrics with anti-microbial properties are being developed and offered to clients. Also, new finishing techniques (anti Covid finishes) are being explored to reinvigorate sales. Product mix is being expanded to include outdoor fabrics and contract fabrics. The Company is expecting better results in future.
The future outlook appears to be better.

In silk fabrics adverse situation, the turnover is expected to increase in financial year 2025-26 as the demand is expected to grow due to an increasing demand from sports, apparel and home furnishing textile products.
